title: How do alternating signs give the remainder on division by eleven?
description: Plus and minus signs are put in front of the digits of three lakh twenty eight thousand one hundred five, starting from the units digit. The plus digits and the minus digits are added, one total is taken from the other, and the answer is read as a remainder. Keeko's doubt is that the minus sign can be dropped.
teaching_notes: One idea: alternating signs from the units digit add up the excess and take away the shortfall in one go, and a minus answer means short of a multiple. Watch for students who drop the minus sign and call the answer the remainder.

source: Use alternating signs to find the remainder of 328105 on div
video_script.why: A learner finds a remainder on division by eleven with one line of alternating signs, and reads a minus total as a number short of a multiple.
video_script.substitution: the book's own number: three lakh twenty eight thousand one hundred five
video_script.anchor: the six digits of 328105 with plus and minus signs in front, as in the book
video_script.wrong_move: drops the minus sign from minus three and says the remainder is three
maths_rules: 328105 has digits 3, 2, 8, 1, 0, 5 from the lakhs to the units
signs from the units digit: +5, −0, +1, −8, +2, −3, which is −3 + 2 − 8 + 1 − 0 + 5
−3 means 3 short of a multiple of 11, so 11 − 3 = 8 more than the multiple before it
video_script.design: One idea: alternating signs from the units digit, then read the total. Assumes the one more, one less pattern of place values. The six digits and their signs stay on the board all video.

beats.on_screen: title card Remainder on division by 11; the six digit number 328105 written large with a question mark after the words divided by 11

marks.scene: the title card arrives and 328105 is written large
marks.ask: the words divided by 11? appear under the number

narration: <bookmark mark='scene'/>This is a question from your book about a six digit number.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>The number is three lakh twenty eight thousand one hundred five.
What remainder does it leave when it is divided by eleven?

beats.on_screen: the question stays on the board while the child thinks

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: the digits 3 2 8 1 0 5 in a row with the units digit 5 at the right end; a plus and a minus sign alternate above the places, starting with plus on the units

marks.units: the units digit 5 lights up with a plus sign
marks.switch: the signs switch on the places, plus then minus then plus
marks.link: plus lands on the one more places and minus on the one less places

beats.colours: plus signs in one colour, minus signs in another
narration: <bookmark mark='units'/>Start from the units digit and give it the plus sign.
<bookmark mark='switch'/>The tens digit gets the minus sign. The signs keep switching, one place after another.
<bookmark mark='link'/>Plus lands on the places that are one more than a multiple of eleven. Minus lands on the places that are one less.

marks.given: the number is written with its digits in a row

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the number is three lakh twenty eight thousand one hundred five.

beats.on_screen: To find: the remainder of 328105 divided by 11

marks.find: the question is written under the given line

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the remainder when this number is divided by eleven.

marks.units: the units digit 5 gets plus and the tens digit 0 gets minus
marks.all: −3 + 2 − 8 + 1 − 0 + 5 is written across the six digits

narration: <bookmark mark='units'/>Step one, put signs in front of the digits, starting from the units digit.
The units digit five gets plus. The tens digit zero gets minus.
<bookmark mark='all'/>Going on, the signs fall as minus three, plus two, minus eight, plus one, minus zero, plus five.
<bookmark mark='plus'/>Step two, work out the expression. The digits with plus are five, one and two, which make eight.
<bookmark mark='minus'/>The digits with minus are zero, eight and three, which make eleven.
<bookmark mark='total'/>Eight take away eleven is minus three.

beats.on_screen: −3 means 3 short of a multiple of 11

marks.read: the words 3 short of a multiple of 11 appear next to −3

narration: <bookmark mark='read'/>Step three, read the total. Minus three means the number is three short of a multiple of eleven.

marks.back: the number line shows 3 short of a multiple, then 8 more than the one before
marks.ans: the answer line is boxed with 328105 = 11 × 29827 + 8

narration: <bookmark mark='back'/>Three short of a multiple of eleven is eight more than the multiple before it.
<bookmark mark='ans'/>The remainder is eight.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the number 328105
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble shows −3, remainder 3; a strip of the remainders 0 to 10 appears, with −3 outside it; the bubble is struck through

marks.doubt: the bubble with −3 and remainder 3 appears
marks.range: a strip of the whole numbers 0 to 10 appears and −3 sits outside it

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks the remainder is three, because the total is minus three and the sign can be dropped.
<bookmark mark='range'/>But a remainder on division by eleven is a whole number from zero to ten.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>Dropping the minus sign changes the meaning. Minus three means three short, so we read it properly.
